idle.action: standing completely in place; open eyes, tiny relaxed breath, one brief closed-eye blink, then reopen; feet and torso stay fixed

walk.action: side-profile walk facing screen-left; a continuous gentle 12-frame gait with alternating foot contacts and natural arm swing; every foot contact shares one ground line; no whole-body lateral slide

sleep.action: curled asleep on the ground, eyes closed, very gentle breathing; compact grounded silhouette

eat.action: cute standing munching reaction with small open-and-close mouth, tiny head nods and paws near the cream belly; feet and torso remain grounded

file_hover.action: anticipatory standing reaction as a file hovers overhead; face looks alert and mouth gradually opens wide; no file icon or detached prop in the artwork

file_consume.action: a clear non-loop consuming reaction after the file is dropped: open mouth, delighted munches, swallow, then settle; no visible file icon or detached prop

poop.action: small grounded squat and embarrassed expression; pose communicates toilet need without detached effects

sick.action: tired unwell standing reaction with droopy eyes, slight hunch, weak sway limited to head and shoulders; feet remain on one ground line

sulk.action: standing pout with lowered brows, tucked hands and a tiny head turn; body remains centered and grounded

dragged.action: being held in midair: arms lifted, feet dangling close together, surprised but cute face; compact body silhouette

fall.action: downward falling sequence through body pose only; no speed lines, dust, shadow, or detached effects

land.action: landing recovery: crouch, soft squash, rise toward a stable standing pose; feet land on one ground line; no impact effect

pet.action: warm response to being petted: happy closed-eye smile, small shoulder lift and paws clasped near chest; same torso size and baseline as idle; no stars or detached effects

play.action: joyful playful reaction: clear happy smile and small two-paw clap/bounce while the torso remains centered; no props, stars, or detached effects

style: soft 3D plush desktop-pet sprite, clean antialiased edges, no outline, childlike proportions, warm pale-pink and cream palette
